subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPitOperations
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle-side AI and pit operations: pit-machine state machine (pit-box alignment, pit-stop readiness, per-frame pit-stop progress with speed limiter and wheel-force ramps), racing-line/path following with target-node traversal, tire physics force computation (sign-selected lookup tables, friction-circle model, wear simulation), tire brand catalog lookup, and AI opponent roster selection.

summary: The packet groups 18 validated functions into two well-bounded regions. (1) A pit-machine cluster (owner CONFIRMED F1CPitMachine for 0x004A5D10/0x004A5FA0/0x004A6200/0x004A68B0): a mode-byte dispatcher reading a vehicle sub-state at obj+0x32C8 and routing through optional delegate objects, a pit-box alignment projection test, a pit-stop readiness evaluation with a speed limiter and camera mode forcing, and a per-frame progress tick that ramps wheel forces, deactivates the limiter, clears AI reason code 9, and notifies state 4 on exit. (2) Tire-physics and vehicle-AI helpers sharing a large float-table-bearing object (mode selector this+0x39B4, contact-patch array this+0x39D0, force tables +0x3C40/+0x3C80, wear slots +0x3D64..0x3D70): grip coefficient, force solvers, wheel/suspension init, engine-wear simulation, racing-line path traversal and path-position tracking, plus a tire-brand table lookup and an AI opponent roster builder. Owners of the tire/physics functions are UNKNOWN in the packet; the shared-field class grouping is DERIVED. All trust is DERIVED/GUESS per worker policy; no new CONFIRMED facts are claimed.

function_roles.role: Pit-machine main AI state dispatcher: stores event mode/value, routes to pit strategy, crew, and delegate sub-objects on mode and vehicle sub-state.
Pit-box alignment readiness test: projection of the relative vehicle-to-target vector against the target rotation basis plus velocity/slip thresholds.
Pit-stop readiness evaluation: wheel-spin gate, camera mode 1, tire-compound decision, pit timer arming and player pit-mid arming.

Per-frame pit-stop progress: wheel-force ramps and speed-limiter ramp while servicing, then pit-exit sequence (limiter deactivation, AI reason clear, state-4 notify, elapsed computation, audio, cleanup).
Builds a performance-ranked, deduplicated AI opponent list with float-key merge sort.
Tire brand name lookup over a 36-byte-stride table, with gated not-found debug logging.
Per-wheel suspension/tire state initialization: wheel offset from chassis origin, suspension parameters, rotation matrix and Euler extraction.
Physics tire system constructor: sub-structure initializers, defaults (this+0x32BC = -1, this+0x39A4 = 0) and post-constructor finalization.
Per-corner tire grip coefficient with anti-roll cross-coupling, mode-selected by this+0x39B4 and clamped to [0,1].
Bisection root solver for a tire contact-force function over sign-selected lookup tables.
Tire force via friction-circle model: sign-selected table interpolation, aero-drag term, clamp and slip-velocity drag return.
Lateral tire grip force with contact-patch capacity accumulation and aero table term.
AI racing-line path traversal: node lookup and chain walk to the target node id, vehicle state copy, suspension/wheel-contact updates, display-node toggles.
Engine wear simulation: FLT_MAX wear-slot init and per-frame noise-driven recomputation gated by dword_7CEA5C in (0,2].
AI vehicle path-position tracking: orientation copy, rotation matrix build, ride-height error accumulation, rigid-body constraint solve.
Conditional tire-scrub reset gated by wear mode; clamps scrub slot +0x3D64 or global dbl_7C91DC.
Audio pitch and wheel-RPM scaling by the speed ratio, flag-gated by byte_7D01C4, then tire brush model solve.
Tire force/torque from a bias-scaled quadratic model gated by enable byte this+0x1EC.

classes.name: F1CPitMachine
classes.responsibility: Owns the pit-stop lifecycle: mode dispatch from event records, pit-box alignment checks, readiness evaluation, per-frame progress/servicing and pit-exit sequencing.

classes.name: F1CVehicleTireSystem
classes.responsibility: Large float-table-bearing tire physics object: grip coefficient, force solvers, lateral force, force/torque model, wear slots, scrub reset and audio pitch scaling. Class grouping is DERIVED from strong field overlap (0x3A70/0x3514/0x3C40/0x3D64/0x32BC) plus the constructor that owns them.

classes.name: F1CAIRacingLineTracker
classes.responsibility: AI racing-line path following and per-frame path-position tracking: node chain traversal, target node resolution, orientation/position state, suspension and wheel-contact updates, rigid-body constraint solving.

classes.name: WheelSuspensionGeometry
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel suspension/tire state initialization against the chassis local origin. Owner is UNKNOWN in the packet; separated from F1CVehicleTireSystem because its wheel-state layout (74-float stride) and origin fields are distinct.

classes.name: AIOpponentSelector
classes.responsibility: Builds the performance-ranked, deduplicated AI opponent roster for path assignment. Owner UNKNOWN; class and list-field layout DERIVED from the single function's output-list writes.

classes.name: TireBrandTable
classes.responsibility: Tire brand name catalog with 36-byte-stride entries and gated not-found debug reporting.

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: The base vehicle object referenced by the pit machine and the AI racing-line tracker (via this+0x0). Fields carry the AI/pit sub-state, target node id, finish state, AI reason code, velocity and wheel-spin vectors, pit-box index, and pit-crew flags. The 'obj' base is kept distinct from the 'this' bases per the no-merge rule; the class name is a proposal.

state_machines.name: PitMachineState
transitions: Event mode byte at a2+8 differs from this+0x184 -> store it and call AIPitStrategyState on the base vehicle
Vehicle sub-state obj+0x32C8 == 2 or 3 -> dispatch on mode this+0x184 (2 -> sub_4A5EA0, 0 -> sub_4A5F20)
PitMid flag fires in the last 2.0s before completion (this+0x1A4)
AI reason code obj+0x4068 == 9 cleared to 0 when the limiter deactivates

state_machines.name: EngineWearMode
transitions: Four wear slots +0x3D64..0x3D70 initialized to FLT_MAX before any mode check
Wear recompute runs per frame when dword_7CEA5C in (0, 2]
Wear value divided by flt_8ACF9C when dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7CEA5C == 2
TireScrubReset clamps wear slot +0x3D64 (or global dbl_7C91DC) gated by dword_7CEA5C

interfaces.name: PitMachineDelegateDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Conditional dispatch into optional pit-machine sub-objects (crew, delegates) guarded by pointer fields this+0x8/+0xC/+0x10 and vehicle-control state.

interfaces.name: TireForceTableQuery
interfaces.purpose: Sign-selected force-table interpolation with friction-circle clamping shared by the tire force solvers.

interfaces.name: TireBrandCatalogQuery
interfaces.purpose: Name-based tire brand lookup over a fixed-stride table.

interfaces.name: OpponentRosterQuery
interfaces.purpose: Performance-ranked opponent list construction with name deduplication and float-key merge sort.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitMachineStateDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve mode-byte dispatch at this+0x184, vehicle sub-state gating at obj+0x32C8 (values 2/3), optional-delegate ordering via this+0x8/+0xC/+0x10, event-value storage at this+0x188, and StateChangeNotify(state 4) on pit exit.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStopTimingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Pit stop timing and limiter-ramp fields must persist: entry this+0x1A0, completion this+0x1A4, elapsed this+0x1A8, mid flag this+0x1AC, limiter base/timestamp/ceiling this+0x1B0..0x1B8, engaged this+0x1C0, wheel-force windows this+0x1C4/0x1D0/0x1D4; limiter deactivation must write the ceiling and clear AI reason code 9 (obj+0x4068).

compatibility_contracts.name: TireForceTableLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Sign-selected force tables (+0x3C40 positive scaled by +0x3C3C, +0x3C80 negative scaled by +0x3C7C), aero tables (+0x3C00 scaled by +0x3BFC, +0x3CC0 scaled by +0x3CBC), contact-patch array +0x39D0 with count +0x39F8 and lerp table +0x39A4, mode selector +0x39B4, and friction-circle slip fields +0x3A70/+0x3514/+0x3518 with a [0,1] clamp.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireWearModeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Four wear slots at +0x3D64..0x3D70 clamp to FLT_MAX; per-frame recompute gated by dword_7CEA5C in (0,2], noise seed dword_8AAE70, optional division by flt_8ACF9C when dword_7C56A4==7 and mode==2; TireScrubReset clamps slot +0x3D64 when the +0x32BC field is nonzero.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioPitchScaleContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame pitch ratio a2 / this+0x3BF4; flag-gated array scaling via byte_7D01C4 bits 0-2 (sub_5881F0 paths, pitch field +0x3984, 8-byte-strided +0x39A4 array, +0x39D0 array scaled by the reciprocal ratio), ending with the TireBrushModelForceSolver call.

compatibility_contracts.name: OpponentRosterLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Output list fields head/tail/secondary/count at this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC; float-pair nodes (8-byte allocation via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper) merge-sorted by float key; roster size read at vehicle-setup +0x14; name dedup with the byte_5EA438 empty fallback.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireBrandTableLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Brand table at this[1] (this+0x4) with a 36-byte stride; entry offset 0 is the brand-name pointer; count at this+0x0; miss path logs a non-existent-tire message gated by dword_7C569C != 5.
